review_description: During the quoting process I recall Marc being the easiest person to deal with. He was quick to reply to questions and often responded late in the evening which was great.We ended up getting a 15kw off-grid system installed with a 20kw lithium ion battery for storage. Mid winter we have the generator on standby which we may use about 10 times per winter.To date we haven’t had any issues with the system at all. We would highly recommend Sivcorp to any off grid buyer.

My name is Andrew Schultz and I live in Mount Gambier in South Australia.I've got a 13KW system, I've got lithium ion batteries, 13KWh of storage power.Â  Their warranty is 10 years with a lifespan of approximately 25 years.Â  The whole system on my current energy bill would pay for itself in less than 5 years.We chose Sivcorp because my power bill was getting very expensive because I run a small horticultural business.Â  I use a lot of power in the cool room and with electricity for irrigation and because the power bills were so over the top.ÂIÂ looked into going solar with a battery backup and Sivcorp came up with the right price.

I'm Andrew Jackson from Mount Gambier and I have a 13KW system put on with 13KWh battery storage and it runs really good. We were paying between $800 to $1,200 a quarter for ourÂ power bills, but once we put the system in we haven't had a power bill since.We haven't had a power black-out for a little while, but the power black-out that we did have, the batteries took over and we still managed to have lights, TV and the internet which made the cook very happy inside!

The overall customer service was very good and streamlined from first contact to finish. I highly recommend the installing team as these guys were the first tradies who actually listened when I've told them to not silicone broken roof tiles during the installation (our roof is old and the tiles are really brittle) but to exchange these. They even went out and bought more tiles to exchange and when these run out, placed the silicon-ed ones into a convenient position for me to exchange the next day. The inverter is installed neatly to the wall. I would give more stars for the installation if I could.I can't judge if it's the best system on the market but I'm really happy with it. We have generated recently on a good sunny day 37kwh which I think is great. Really nice is the inverter display showing what is currently generated and what is being used / fed into the grit. I took a star of as I think the Wifi connection to the Sungrow server seems to happen randomly - might be only due to my limited IT skills. As well, I've adjusted the system time after daylight saving and although it was completed successfully the time changes back to the original setting after a few minutes. Both these points aren't a deal breaker but it's just not 5 Stars.I would definitely do it again.
